meta.experiment: E9 - prequential live-RAG with held-out separation + CIs
meta.retriever: HashingVectorizer char_wb 3-5grams + cosine (no fitted vocab; reproducible)
meta.note: Prequential test-then-train: each incident is predicted from PRIOR incidents only (exact duplicates excluded = held-out separation), then ingested. no_rag = running most-frequent mitigation; live_rag = leakage-free kNN (the honest number); leaky_rag = kNN whose pool includes the current incident (the inflated number a leak-prone eval reports). The leaky-minus-honest gap is the leakage hazard R2-10 flagged.
